page.layout: One printed page, verse throughout. Top: a block of verse with a large initial E, closing with a signature line in small caps. Below a rule: a heading block (title of a gratulatory poem), then a verse block with a large initial J, closing with a signature line. Bottom left: a library stamp (not transcribed). Bottom centre: a printer's ornament (not transcribed). Faint show-through from the facing page at the right edge and in the margins (not transcribed).

main_text.p: E Mentita ruit Papæ sub CLAVE potestas, Atque minax ejus fulmen, formidine mentes Mortales solvit, vilescunt mercis iniquæ Fragmina: dum Ductore Deo penetralia pandis Verbi sacrati; CLAVES ut jura capessant Proxima, sintque diu veris asserta Ministris. Rem magnam præstas; quis enim sua fulmina possit Extorquere Jovi? sed tu superare labores Heroum spectaris; ovans cum fulmina sæva Ab Jove Romano rapis, & victricia portas Arma, quibus victus, mundo non amplius optat Insultare, (: pudor si quis :) Regésque movere.
VALENTINUS KOTSI, Hung. Scholæ Refor. Papensis olim Rector, nunc exul pro testimonio Jesu.
main_text.head: Carmen gratulatorium ad Præstantissimum & Doctissimum Dominum Autorem & Respondentem, popularem suum, & peregrinationis Achatem.
main_text.p: JUlius arma parans Tyberina recondit in antra CLAVES, extollens talia verba, PETRI: Hic gladius Pauli nos nunc defendat ab hoste, Quandoquidem CLAVIS nil juvat ista Petri. Quid tu? bella petis? minimè; non Martis in aula Est pietas, bellis exulat ulla fides. Ergò quid? Ambabus CLAVES amplecteris ulnis Cœlorum, tentas queis referare polum. Euge tibi virtute pares, quod surgat ad astra Nomen, & obscuro ne capiare loco!
